spec.description: Regression triage for all repositories. The board answers two questions: which tests are regressed now, and does every repository still report? This board has no repository filter. To examine one repository, open Repo Health. To examine one test, click its name - Test Details opens.

The number of regressed tests in all repositories. A test is regressed when all three are true: it is more than the slowdown threshold slower than its typical (baseline) duration, the slowdown is more than 1 second, and the baseline window has 10 or more runs. A healthy value is 0.
spec.title: Regressed tests now

spec.description: The time since each repository last reported test results. A healthy value is below the repository's CI interval, usually one day. A larger value means the CI job or the metrics upload is broken. Repair it before you trust that repository's numbers on this board.
spec.title: Hours since last run (per repo)

spec.description:
The 200 tests with the largest change against their own baseline, one row per combination of test name and server version. Before a baseline exists, the table shows the 200 slowest tests instead. A test outside the top 200 can still be regressed; the "Regressions right now" table below shows every regressed test. Click a test name to open it in Test Details.

Columns:
- trend: red up = slower, green down = faster
- typical (recent): the median duration over the recent window
- typical (baseline): the median duration over the baseline window
- last run: the duration of the most recent run
- change (s) / change (%): typical (recent) minus typical (baseline)
- runs counted: the number of runs in the baseline window; be careful with small values
- verdict: REGRESSION when the test matches the regression rule (see "Regressed tests now")
spec.title: Top 200 tests that changed the most ($branch)

spec.description: Every test that matches the regression rule now. A test is regressed when all three are true: it is more than the slowdown threshold slower than its typical (baseline) duration, the slowdown is more than 1 second, and the baseline window has 10 or more runs. The value shows how many times slower the test is (2.0 = twice as slow). A healthy table is empty.
spec.title: Regressions right now - all repositories

spec.description: The number of regressed tests in each repository. A healthy board shows every bar green at 0. A red bar shows which repository to examine in the table below.
spec.title: Regressed tests per repo

spec.description: The number of regressed tests on each day, for each repository. A healthy line falls to zero as fixes arrive. A step up shows the day a slowdown started. A repository appears only on days when it had regressed tests.
spec.title: Regressed tests over time

spec.expr:
(
    max by (test_id, vcs_repository_name, server_version) (
      quantile_over_time(0.5, cae_v16_test_duration_seconds{server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[$recent])
    )
  /
    max by (test_id, vcs_repository_name, server_version) (
      quantile_over_time(0.5, cae_v16_test_duration_seconds{server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[$baseline] offset $recent)
    )
  - 1
)
and
max by (test_id, vcs_repository_name, server_version) (
  quantile_over_time(0.5, cae_v16_test_duration_seconds{server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[$baseline] offset $recent)
) > 0.1

spec.description: How much each test changed between the baseline window and the recent window. Only tests with a typical duration of 0.1 seconds or more are included. A healthy shape is one narrow peak at 0%. A tail to the right is a group of tests that became slower. A peak that moved to the right means the runs became slower as a whole - examine the runner or the infrastructure, not single tests.
spec.title: How much each test changed (recent vs baseline)

spec.description: The 20 tests that became slower by the largest amount, in all repositories: typical (recent) minus typical (baseline). When a test runs against more than one server version, the bar shows the slowest version. Click a bar to open the test in Test Details.
spec.title: Top 20 biggest slowdowns (recent vs baseline)
